title: The heat equation and independence of the spectrum of the Hodge Laplacian on $\ell^p$
summary: We study the heat equation associated to the Hodge Laplacian on simplicial complexes. Using recently developed techniques for magnetic Schrödinger operators, we prove Davies-Gaffney-Grigoryan type estimates for the kernel of the heat semigroup on $\ell^2,$ which we then use to extend the semigroup to $\ell^p$ for $p\in[1,\infty]$ under suitable curvature and volume growth conditions. Furthermore, we establish $p$-independence of the Hodge Laplacian spectrum under the assumption of form bounded curvature and uniform subexponential volume growth.
